_readme: S593 SkyTadpole, 2026-11-06. Step 12 names Ohlone next (146 of 179 on with_closed_list). Lessons (S451) found 15 of the 33 gaps are credit programs the 2026-2027 guide does not print under the state's lists (the college's to settle in COCI), and 18 noncredit certificates that sit on the college's noncredit web page, which the chapter 7 PDF does not carry. This read lists that page's links and the text near the certificates' names, so a session can tell whether each certificate's page prints its courses (a source the capture can take) before any reader change or paid read. Two loads, no model call. Second read (run 42225429355 found the landing page names no certificate): its Noncredit Certificates page, /noncredit/noncredit-certificates.
